assumptions: Invoices arrive as structured JSON; invoice line extraction from PDFs is out of scope.
Approver identity is asserted by the caller and trusted (no authentication).
Vendor, purchase-order, invoice-history, FX and ledger systems are simulated fixtures.

inferences.text: Both invoice lines match PO-1001 and the recorded goods receipts within the goods tolerance.
The total commitment is within a Cost Centre Manager's delegated limit.

citations.quote: supplier legal name, invoice number, invoice date, currency, gross amount

policy_findings.observed: 1 prior invoice(s) for vendor; none match

citations.quote: The first subsequent payment requires Financial Control co-approval

policy_findings.expected: active vendor; payment instructions match the vendor master
policy_findings.rule: FIN-POL-004 §2, §4 vendor status and bank details

citations.quote: Freight may vary by up to AUD 75

policy_findings.expected: invoice, PO PO-1001 and receipts agree within tolerance
policy_findings.observed: 2 line(s) matched; quantities received; total within tolerance
policy_findings.threshold: lower of absolute limit and % of PO line value (FIN-POL-002 §2)

citations.quote: new vendor less than 30 days old

policy_findings.observed: required role: Cost Centre Manager (limit AUD 10,000.00); no higher-risk triggers
no case free text and no model-flagged indicators
policy_findings.rule: FIN-POL-005 §3-4 fraud indicators in untrusted content
